body:
## Why
Five places in `src/dispatch.js` and all of `src/jobs.js` branch on the profile mode; every verb of this track needs one interface instead (`docs/local-first.md` §4). The reap has a live bug: `reapDecision` returns early without a pid, and a parked background job has none (§4, last paragraph; §11).

## What
1. `src/runtime/index.js`: `runtimeFor(attempt | profile)` → the adapter (`manual` rows → manual; `job`/`bg` → claude-bg; `pid` → process; by profile `mode` at launch).
2. `src/runtime/process.js`, `claude-bg.js` (today's `src/jobs.js` moved), `manual.js`: each exports `launch(ctx, task, k, opts)` (the corresponding tail of `spawnWorker`), `inspect(ctx, attempt, { jobs })` → `{ alive, working, handle, session }`, `stop(ctx, attempt)` (`claude stop` / SIGTERM→SIGKILL as today), and `pause`/`resume` that return `{ ok: false, why: 'not implemented until B4' }` for now.
3. `src/dispatch.js`: `spawnWorker` delegates its tail to `runtime.launch`; the reclaim loop's liveness branches become one `inspect` per running card; `failAttempt`'s kill and the reap call `runtime.stop`; `watchChild` unchanged in behaviour. `listKbJobs` stays one call per tick, inside the claude-bg adapter, passed in through `{ jobs }`.
4. `reapDecision` (`src/model.js`): drop `|| !job.pid`; `test/reap.test.js` fixtures stop carrying a pid the listing never has, and gain the parked-job case.
5. `test/fake-runtime.js`: an in-memory adapter recording launches, stops, pauses; `test/runtime.test.js`: the same liveness scenarios run against every adapter with the fake harness.

## Done when
- [ ] `grep -n "mode === 'process'\|mode === 'claude-bg'\|\.bg\b\|\.job\b" src/dispatch.js` finds nothing outside `runtimeFor` selection.
- [ ] Every existing test passes; `test/reap.test.js` has a parked job (no pid, `state: blocked`) on a done card being stopped.
- [ ] `hkb dispatch --dry-run --json` on this board is byte-identical before and after (hashes in the PR).
- [ ] Wiki: `architecture/overview.md` "Workers are any harness" names the seam; `features/runtime-seam.md` is left to the root.

## Contract
The five function names above and their return shapes are the contract B3/B4 build on. Three adapters only (the Actions runner is gone, A2).

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: the tick never branches on a profile mode; src/runtime/* export launch/inspect/stop/pause/resume; test/fake-runtime.js lets tick tests run without claude; reapDecision no longer gates on a pid; behaviour otherwise unchanged
title: The runtime seam: src/runtime/{process,claude-bg,manual}.js, a fake runtime, and the reap pid-gate fix
